title: Dota 2
note: Twitch category 29595 corresponds to IGDB game 2963. Evidence, rechecked 2026-11-21: Twitch's Get Games names category 29595 Dota 2 and gives it no igdb_id; IGDB's own Twitch record of category 29595 (external_games, source 14) names game 2963, Dota 2, whose IGDB Steam record is app 570 (Dota 2 on Steam).

title: Counter-Strike
note: A series category: Twitch renamed its Counter-Strike: Global Offensive category to Counter-Strike on 25 Sep 2023, and on 2026-11-21 both Counter-Strike 2 (IGDB 242408, Steam app 730) and Counter-Strike: Global Offensive (IGDB 1372, Steam app 4465480, free) are on Steam, so its streams can be either game. IGDB's own record links the category to Counter-Strike: Global Offensive alone, so it is listed as the Counter-Strike series, never as one game (no_match until 0.19). Source: https://consolepcgaming.com/twitch-farewells-counter-strike-global-offensive-renames-the-category-to-counter-strike
